content_data.project_title: Enhancing User Experience Through Narrative-Driven Content Strategy for Food-Tech Platform
content_data.project_description: A comprehensive proposal to revitalize the user journey on our food-tech platform by integrating compelling narrative content, improving engagement, and fostering a stronger brand connection.
content_data.timeline: 6 months, with an initial 2-month discovery and strategy phase, followed by a 4-month content development and implementation phase.
objectives: Establish a consistent brand voice and narrative across all user-facing platform content.
Improve customer satisfaction scores related to content clarity and helpfulness by 10%.
deliverables: Revised Content Strategy Document with Narrative Framework
Comprehensive User Journey Content Audit Report
In-App Feature Explanation Content (Microcopy, Tooltips, Help Articles)
